rows.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent square game specialization icon for Grave Accord. The referenced image is only a style, materials and icon framing reference; create a NEW distinct object, preserve the reference file unchanged. Match its hand painted, worn charcoal iron, subdued brass, olive leather, softly lit dark fantasy equipment illustration. Center one strong readable equipment silhouette with at least 22 percent completely transparent padding on all four sides. Make the object wide rather than a tall folded carry wall. No environment, no character, no lettering, no numerals, no arrows, no border, no particles, no magical glow, no glossy plastic. Actual transparent alpha background. Restrained detailed brushwork, convincing rivets and wear, clear at small HUD size. Subject: Interception Line. A broad shallow bowed interception shield, seen from a slightly elevated front three-quarter angle, with a low wide iron face, two brass reinforcing ribs, and a simple olive leather rear grip just visible. It is a compact directional screening baffle carried ahead during a brief charge. One single solid object; no folded hinge panels, no planted feet, no rails. A decisive broad shoulder-like silhouette.
